cloud_syncSwarm sync & seeding

Self-contained live MedOS torrent. While the app is open, seeding starts automatically. Tick rooms for selective download, or leave empty for the full tree. Save path for any external client: parent of MedOS.

infoIn-app libtorrent is unavailable — open the magnet in qBittorrent/Transmission with download location set to the parent of your MedOS folder.

Power users: open the same magnet in uTorrent/qBittorrent with save path parent of MedOS (must be the parent folder — e.g. C:\ not C:\MedOS). Do not run two clients on the same folder at once — close uTorrent while seeding in-app.
